title: Diriger une réunion
goal: Animer une réunion et la faire aboutir.
points: Ouvre et cadre : « Let's get started. The aim of today's meeting is… »
Fais avancer : « Let's move on to the next point. » ; recentre : « Could we stick to the agenda? »
Interromps poliment : « Sorry to interrupt, but… » ; donne la parole : « Koffi, what's your view? »
Conclus : « To sum up… » ou « So, to recap, the action points are… »
examples: The aim of today's meeting is to choose a new carrier.
L'objectif de la réunion d'aujourd'hui est de choisir un nouveau transporteur.
Let's move on to the next point on the agenda.
Passons au point suivant de l'ordre du jour.
Sorry to interrupt, but we are running out of time.
Désolé de vous interrompre, mais nous manquons de temps.
To sum up, Awa will contact the bank by Friday.
Pour résumer, Awa contactera la banque d'ici vendredi.

exercises.prompt: La discussion s'éloigne du sujet. Que dis-tu ?
options: Could we stick to the agenda, please?
Stop talking now.
Could we glue to the agenda?
You are out of the subject.
exercises.explain: « Could we stick to the agenda? » recentre la réunion poliment.

exercises.sentence: Let's move ___ to the next item.
options: on
in
up
off
exercises.explain: « to move on » = passer à la suite.

exercises.audio: Sorry to interrupt, but we're running out of time.
options: Sorry to interrupt, but we're running out of time.
Sorry to interrupt, but we're running out of tea.
Sorry to interrupt, but we're running on time.
Sorry, I interrupt, but we're running out of time.
exercises.explain: « running out of time » = manquer de temps.

exercises.fr: Pour résumer, nous changeons de transporteur.
exercises.answer: To sum up we are changing carriers
exercises.explain: « To sum up » = pour résumer (« resume » est un faux ami).

exercises.sentence: Koffi, what's your ___ on this proposal?
options: view
sight
look
vision
exercises.explain: « What's your view on…? » = quel est ton avis sur… ?

options: Let's get started. The aim of today's meeting is to agree on the budget.
Okay, so, yes, hmm, budget.
We begin the meeting of the budget.
Start! Budget now.
exercises.explain: On lance la réunion et on annonce clairement son objectif.

exercises.fr: Qui est responsable de cette action ?
exercises.answer: Who is responsible for this action point
exercises.explain: « responsible for » (et non « of ») = responsable de.

exercises.audio: So, to recap, Awa will call the bank on Friday.
options: So, to recap, Awa will call the bank on Friday.
So, to recap, Ama will call the bank on Friday.
So, to recap, Awa will call the bank on Thursday.
So, to recap, Awa called the bank on Friday.

exercises.text: Let's move on to the next point on the agenda.
exercises.fr: Passons au point suivant de l'ordre du jour.

author: claude
